title.en: A line that ends where the net ends, or while the net goes on
title.zh: 线终于网尽之处，或网续而线终

statement.en: On a way and a level cut by a need, under the regime's premises the line never ends exactly where the course as it was, the need met, is first marked and its level one step later is at or above the kept kind's point of no return. Unmarked and losing more than it is given, it ends where the net ends.
statement.zh: 一种延续的方式连同一个水位，水位不足所需即无后继。在体制的前提下，线不穷，当且仅当照旧的进程在所需一直满足之下第一次落在标记水位，而一步之后的水位不低于所保持之类的不可返回点。无标记而所失多于所得，则线终于网尽之处。

laws.en: One step takes a way w and a level x to (after w x, left w x), Mechanism.adaptive's step with the level in adaptive's second place; the net is that step where the level is at least the need and nothing where it is below, and at a need of nothing it is the whole step. AloneOutside: at every level not marked, the way after a step is alone of the way; the step as it was takes alone at every level.
laws.zh: 一步把方式 w 与水位 x 带到 (after w x, left w x)，即 Mechanism.adaptive 的步，水位居其第二位；网是这一步在水位不低于所需之处，低于所需则无后继，所需为零时即整步。AloneOutside：凡未标记的水位，一步之后的方式是 alone 作用于原方式；“照旧的步”在一切水位都取 alone。

laws.en: The class of ways is constant up to the net's end exactly where no two levels that meet the need give one way two different ways after a step. Its core does not relate a configuration whose level meets the need to one of the same way whose level is below it.
laws.zh: 方式之类至终有常，当且仅当满足所需的任何两个水位都不使同一方式在一步之后成为两种方式。它的核不把水位满足所需的构形与同一方式而水位低于所需的构形相联。

laws.en: The class of ways is constant exactly where, from a level that meets the need, every level meets it and gives one way the same way after a step; so, given some way, exactly where the need is nothing and no level makes a difference to the way after a step; at a need of nothing, exactly where it is constant under Mechanism.adaptive's step (adaptive_constant_iff).
laws.zh: 方式之类有常，当且仅当自一个满足所需的水位起，一切水位都满足所需并给出同一方式；故在给定某一方式时，当且仅当所需为零且任何水位都不影响一步之后的方式；所需为零时，恰是它在 Mechanism.adaptive 的步之下有常之处（adaptive_constant_iff）。

laws.en: With AloneOutside and no marked level that meets the need, the class of a kind of ways is constant up to the net's end where alone takes ways of one kind to ways of one kind, and so is the class of ways. For marks from low to high, no level that meets the need is marked exactly where high is below low or below the need.
laws.zh: 有 AloneOutside 且满足所需的水位无一被标记时，凡 alone 把同一类别的方式带到同一类别的方式，这一类别之类至终有常，方式之类也是。标记取自 low 至 high 时，满足所需的水位无一被标记，当且仅当 high 低于 low 或低于所需。

laws.en: With AloneOutside, up to the first marked level of the course as it was, the course is the course as it was, whose way after n steps is alone taken n times; with no marked level that meets the need, lines of n steps from one way at two levels reach one way.
laws.zh: 有 AloneOutside 时，在照旧进程第一个被标记的水位之前，进程就是照旧的进程，其 n 步之后的方式是 alone 连取 n 次；满足所需的水位无一被标记时，自同一方式、两个水位出发的 n 步之线到达同一方式。

laws.en: With AloneOutside, no marked level that meets a positive need, and the level of the course as it was given at most r and taking more than r at every step, the line reaches, within as many steps as the start's level, a configuration that conditions nothing, its way alone taken that many times.
laws.zh: 有 AloneOutside、所需为正且满足所需的水位无一被标记，而照旧进程的水位每一步至多得 r、所失多于 r，则线在不多于起始水位的步数之内到达一个不为任何事之缘的构形，其方式是 alone 连取那么多次。

laws.en: RegimeMargin's step is in that form where nothing gives from nothing; and the regime meets those premises where giving is short of H below y, every way on alone's orbit uses at least H and the start is below H + y.
laws.zh: 无中不生有时，RegimeMargin 的步即此形式；给还在 y 以下不足 H、alone 轨道上每一方式取用不少于 H、起始低于 H + y 时，体制满足上述前提。

laws.en: With AloneOutside, decided marks and the course as it was coming below the need, the line never ends exactly where there is a step T of the course as it was, the need met and no level marked before it, the need met and the level marked at it, from whose next configuration the line never ends.
laws.zh: 有 AloneOutside、标记可判定且照旧进程会落到所需之下时，线不穷，当且仅当照旧进程有一步 T：此前所需皆满足且水位皆未标记，此步所需满足且水位被标记，而自其下一构形起线不穷。

laws.en: From a way of a kind every step keeps and that uses H₂, with nothing given from nothing, giving short of H₂ below y₂ and meeting it from y₂ up to hi, the step under H₂ keeping the level within hi, a positive need at most H₂ + y₂ and the level at most hi, the line never ends exactly where the level is at or above H₂ + y₂.
laws.zh: 自一个属于“每一步都保持、取用为 H₂”之类的方式起，无中不生有，给还在 y₂ 以下不足 H₂、自 y₂ 至 hi 足以抵 H₂，H₂ 之下的步使水位不出 hi，所需为正且不超过 H₂ + y₂，水位不超过 hi：线不穷，当且仅当水位不低于 H₂ + y₂。

laws.en: With the premises of the two theorems above, a way after a marked step of the kept kind, giving short of H₁ below y₁, every way on alone's orbit using at least H₁ and the start below H₁ + y₁ and at most hi: the line never ends exactly where there is such a step T and the level of the course as it was at T + 1 is at or above H₂ + y₂.
laws.zh: 在以上两定理的前提之下，标记水位上一步之后的方式属于所保持之类，给还在 y₁ 以下不足 H₁，alone 轨道上每一方式取用不少于 H₁，起始低于 H₁ + y₁ 且不超过 hi：线不穷，当且仅当有这样的一步 T，且照旧进程在 T + 1 的水位不低于 H₂ + y₂。

laws.en: At a level that meets the need, where the way after the step is of another kind, the configuration ends under the kind's class and still conditions something; with AloneOutside, a kind alone keeps and some unmarked level that meets the need, the kind's class is then not constant up to the net's end at that configuration's class. Both hold at every need.
laws.zh: 在满足所需的水位上，若一步之后的方式属于另一类别，该构形在类别之类下终止而仍为他事之缘；有 AloneOutside、alone 保持类别、且有一个满足所需而未标记的水位时，类别之类在该构形的本类上不是至终有常。两者对任何所需皆成立。

laws.en: Under RuleCapture's Raises and ReadsShare and favouring kept upward, Accrues not assumed, the configurations of ClosedCapture's joined two-level step whose A and R parts are Locked form a region closed under the step; at a Locked member, the beyond a whole number, ClosedCapture.lockedAlike meets «本类至终有常» and «所缘同于» there.
laws.zh: 在 RuleCapture 的 Raises、ReadsShare 与“偏向向上保持”之下，不假设 Accrues，ClosedCapture 的合并两层步中 A、R 两部分为 Locked 的构形，构成在该步之下封闭的区域；在一个 Locked 的成员处（其外为自然数时），ClosedCapture.lockedAlike 满足「本类至终有常」与「所缘同于」。

laws.en: Under RuleCapture's Raises and ReadsShare and favouring kept upward, along the way's step as it was (windowAlone) a Locked way stays Locked. So, with AloneOutside at windowAlone, a positive need, no marked level that meets it, and the level of the course as it was given at most r and losing more than r at every step, a Locked start reaches a configuration that conditions nothing, still Locked.
laws.zh: 在 RuleCapture 的 Raises、ReadsShare 与“偏向向上保持”之下，沿照旧的步（windowAlone），Locked 的方式保持 Locked。故有 windowAlone 处的 AloneOutside、所需为正、满足所需的水位皆无标记、照旧进程的水位每步得至多 r 而失多于 r 时，自 Locked 起，线到达一个无所缘的构形，仍为 Locked。

laws.en: Regrouped with ClosedCapture.loopPart as the way and ClosedCapture.loss as the level, the course of PoolFromCourse.windowRead is at every step the orbit of the pair (windowAfter, windowLeft), on PoolFromCourse's paced too; the course read by joinRead is that pair's course as it was (windowAlone); outside [N, K) windowAfter is windowAlone; and the two courses agree until the second's level first lies in [N, K).
laws.zh: 按 loopPart 为方式、loss 为水位重新分组后，windowRead 的进程每一步都是配对 (windowAfter, windowLeft) 的轨道，在 paced 上亦然；joinRead 所读的进程是它的照旧进程；[N, K) 之外 windowAfter 即 windowAlone；两进程一致，直到后者水位初入 [N, K)。

laws.en: Witness: giving min z (12 − z), a use of five as it was and three for the kept kind, a need of one, from the level nine; the course as it was runs nine, eight, six, two, nothing. First marked at nine or eight, the line never ends; first marked at six, it turns with two left and ends two steps later, its line under the class of ways ending at six while the net goes on; unmarked, it ends as it was.
laws.zh: 见证：给还为 min z (12 − z)，照旧取用五，所保持之类取用三，所需为一，自水位九起；照旧的进程依次为九、八、六、二、零。第一次标记在九或八，线不穷；第一次标记在六，转时余二，再两步而终，其在方式之类下的线终于六而网仍续；无标记，则照旧而终。

laws.en: For a level course X that never rises with X 0 ≤ hi, FromNothing, Short, Meets and Keeps at H with y up to hi and 0 < need ≤ H + y, the feasible courses X turned to the use H at some step (turned, Turned) and the need met at every step asked (MeetsNeed): the turn at T meets the need exactly where H + y ≤ X T (turned_meets_iff), and X is recoverable at N exactly where H + y ≤ X N (recoverable_iff_above).
laws.zh: X 从不上升且 X 0 ≤ hi，无中不生有，H 处以 y 至 hi 有 Short、Meets、Keeps，0 < need ≤ H + y；可行者为 X 在某步转向用量 H（Turned），所求为每步满足所需：在 T 转向者满足所需，当且仅当 H + y ≤ X T；X 在 N 可恢复，当且仅当 H + y ≤ X N（recoverable_iff_above）。

laws.en: noReturnAt_iff_first_below: under the same premises, N is the point of no return of X (ReadOffInTime's NoReturnAt) exactly where X N < H + y and H + y ≤ X n for every n < N: the first step at which the level is below RegimeMargin's point of no return, a level. Where X comes below H + y it has one (noReturnAt_of_below).
laws.zh: noReturnAt_iff_first_below：同样前提下，N 是 X 的不可返回点（ReadOffInTime 的 NoReturnAt），当且仅当 X N < H + y 而此前每步 H + y ≤ X n：即水位第一次低于 RegimeMargin 的不可返回点（一个水位）的那一步。X 一旦低于 H + y 便有此点（noReturnAt_of_below）。

laws.en: course_turned: with AloneOutside, turns, kept, uses and the level's step RegimeMargin.step giving (use w), for T the first step at which the level of the course as it was is marked, the pair's level at every step t is turned X giving H₂ (T + 1) t, X the level course as it was. No premise on the need.
laws.zh: course_turned：有 AloneOutside、turns、kept、uses，水位的步为 RegimeMargin.step giving (use w)，T 为照旧进程的水位第一次落在标记上的一步：这个对在每一步 t 的水位即 turned X giving H₂ (T + 1) t，X 为照旧的水位进程。对所需无前提。

laws.en: noReturn_exists: under turns_in_time_iff's premises on the regime and on the course as it was, the course as it was has a point of no return N ≤ x. turns_in_time_iff_before: under all of turns_in_time_iff's premises, the line never ends exactly where there is a first marked step T, the need met there and before, and that point N with T + 1 < N.
laws.zh: noReturn_exists：在 turns_in_time_iff 关于体制与照旧进程的前提下，照旧的进程有不可返回点 N ≤ x。turns_in_time_iff_before：在其全部前提下，线不穷，当且仅当有第一个标记步 T，其时及此前所需皆满足，且 T + 1 < N。

laws.en: Three.noReturn: for Three from (true, 9) as it was (9, 8, 6, 2, 0), with the kept kind's use three and a need of one, the point of no return is step 3: first marked at step 0 or 1, T + 1 < 3 (Three.goes_on); at step 2, T + 1 = 3 (Three.turned_and_ends).
laws.zh: Three.noReturn：Three 自 (true, 9) 照旧而行（9、8、6、2、0），所保持之类用量为三、所需为一，其不可返回点是第 3 步：第一次标记在第 0 或第 1 步时 T + 1 < 3（Three.goes_on），在第 2 步时 T + 1 = 3（Three.turned_and_ends）。

laws.en: held_above: with nothing given from nothing, giving short of H below y, a use U at least H and a level c above nothing that the step under U leaves no lower, H + y ≤ c.
laws.zh: held_above：无中不生有，给还在 y 以下不足 H，用量 U 不少于 H，水位 c 高于零且 U 之下的一步不使之降低：H + y ≤ c。

laws.en: unending_iff_above_kept_below: from a way of the kept kind, whose ways use H₂, at a level at most hi, under unending_iff_above's regime premises and need, with c above nothing, the kind kept by every step only at a level from H₂ + y₂ up to below c, every way's step taking every level from c up to hi to one from c up to hi, and every way the course reaches using at least H₂: the line never ends exactly where the level is at or above H₂ + y₂.
laws.zh: unending_iff_above_kept_below：自所保持之类、取用 H₂ 的方式，水位不高于 hi，在 unending_iff_above 的体制前提与所需之下，c 高于零，该类只需在 H₂ + y₂ 至 c 以下的水位被每一步保持，每个方式的一步把 c 至 hi 的水位带到 c 至 hi，进程所到的方式取用皆不少于 H₂：线不穷，当且仅当水位不低于 H₂ + y₂。

laws.en: turns_in_time_iff_kept_below: turns_in_time_iff with kept replaced by the kind kept only at a level from H₂ + y₂ up to below a positive c, every way's step taking every level from c up to hi to one from c up to hi, and every way the pair's course reaches from a way of the kept kind using at least H₂; and the start at most hi replaced by the level of the course as it was after every marked step at most hi. Its conclusion is turns_in_time_iff's.
laws.zh: turns_in_time_iff_kept_below：turns_in_time_iff，其 kept 换为该类只在 H₂ + y₂ 至正数 c 以下的水位被保持、每个方式的一步把 c 至 hi 的水位带到 c 至 hi、自所保持之类的方式起这个对的进程所到方式取用皆不少于 H₂；起点不高于 hi 换为照旧进程在每个标记步之后的水位不高于 hi。结论与 turns_in_time_iff 同。

laws.en: unending_iff_above and turns_in_time_iff are the case c := hi + 1 of the two laws above. kept_or_marked: with AloneOutside, decided marks and a way after a marked step of the kept kind, a kind kept by every step at the levels from lo up to below c is kept by every step, or every level from lo up to below c is marked.
laws.zh: unending_iff_above 与 turns_in_time_iff 是以上两律在 c := hi + 1 时的情形。kept_or_marked：有 AloneOutside、标记可判定、标记步之后的方式属于所保持之类时，在 lo 至 c 以下的水位被每一步保持的类，要么被每一步保持，要么 lo 至 c 以下的每个水位都被标记。

laws.en: locked_alone_not_below: under RuleCapture's Raises and ReadsShare and favouring kept upward, from a Locked way, along the lock's step as it was (windowAlone) taken n times the share and the rule are never below the start's, for every n.
laws.zh: locked_alone_not_below：在 RuleCapture 的 Raises、ReadsShare 与偏向向上保持之下，自 Locked 的方式起，沿锁照旧的步（windowAlone）走 n 步，份额与规则都不低于起点的，对每个 n 皆然。

laws.en: locked_ends_with_net_regime: with the level's step RegimeMargin.step giving (use w), the lock's premises, AloneOutside at windowAlone, a positive need no marked level meets, nothing given from nothing, giving short of H below y, every way whose share and rule are not below the start's using at least H (draws), and the start below H + y: a Locked start reaches, within as many steps as the start's level, a configuration that conditions nothing, still Locked.
laws.zh: locked_ends_with_net_regime：水位的步为 RegimeMargin.step giving (use w)，锁的前提，windowAlone 处的 AloneOutside，所需为正且无标记水位满足它，无中不生有，给还在 y 以下不足 H，份额与规则不低于起点的方式取用皆不少于 H（draws），起点低于 H + y：自 Locked 的起点，线在不多于起点水位的步数之内到达无所缘的构形，仍为 Locked。

laws.en: locked_ends_on_window: locked_ends_with_net_regime with the way after a step windowAfter fA hA hL N K reads and the levels in [N, K) marked; it asks K ≤ N or K ≤ need (un), under which no marked level meets the need. The start below H + y and the floor on the use are given in both.
laws.zh: locked_ends_on_window：locked_ends_with_net_regime，一步之后的方式为 windowAfter fA hA hL N K reads，[N, K) 中的水位被标记；要求 K ≤ N 或 K ≤ need（un），此时无标记水位满足所需。两者中起点低于 H + y 与用量的下限都是给定的。

laws.en: window_corrected: where every step reads and the window's reading hL gives a rule of which kept holds at every level in [N, K), whatever the share and rule in force, the rule after a step of windowAfter fA hA hL N K reads at such a level is kept.
laws.zh: window_corrected：每一步都读取，且窗口的读取 hL 在 [N, K) 的每个水位都给出满足 kept 的规则（无论份额与现行规则如何）时，windowAfter fA hA hL N K reads 在这样的水位走一步之后的规则满足 kept。

laws.en: locked_turns_in_time_on_window_iff: turns_in_time_iff_kept_below on the window, the kept kind the ways whose rule is kept: under the lock's premises from a Locked start, every step reading, the reading giving a kept rule in [N, K), N ≤ H₂ + y₂, c ≤ K, ways with a kept rule using H₂ and every way at least H₂, nothing given from nothing, RegimeMargin's premises for H₂ up to hi, a positive need at most H₂ + y₂, c positive, safe, giving short of H₁ below y₁, the floor H₁ where share and rule are not below the start's, the start below H₁ + y₁, and the level after each step the window reads at most hi: the line never ends exactly where, at the first step of the lock's own course in [N, K), the need met there and before, the level one step later is at or above H₂ + y₂.
laws.zh: locked_turns_in_time_on_window_iff：窗口上的 turns_in_time_iff_kept_below，所保持之类为规则满足 kept 的方式：在锁的前提下自 Locked 的起点，每一步都读取，读取在 [N, K) 给出 kept 的规则，N ≤ H₂ + y₂，c ≤ K，规则 kept 的方式取用 H₂、每个方式不少于 H₂，无中不生有，RegimeMargin 在 H₂ 处以 y₂ 至 hi 的前提（Short、Meets、Keeps），所需为正且不超过 H₂ + y₂，c 为正，safe，y₁ 以下所给不足 H₁，份额与规则不低于起点处的下限 H₁，起点低于 H₁ + y₁，窗口所读之步后的水位不高于 hi：线不穷，当且仅当在锁自己的进程第一个落在 [N, K) 的一步（此处及此前所需皆满足），一步之后的水位不低于 H₂ + y₂。

laws.en: Three.lock_ends: on the lock's own types (the share a number by ≤, the rule false below true, the rule read true from a share of three up, a use of five under true and three under false, no level marked), from (3, true, 0) at nine every premise of locked_ends_with_net_regime holds and the line ends in four steps at ((3, true, 4), 0), Locked; (2, true) is not Locked. Along it the share stays three (lock_share_stays).
laws.zh: Three.lock_ends：在锁自己的类型上（份额为按 ≤ 排序的数，规则 false 低于 true，份额三起读出 true，true 下用五、false 下用三，无标记），自九处的 (3, true, 0)，locked_ends_with_net_regime 的前提皆成立，线四步终于 ((3, true, 4), 0)，仍 Locked；(2, true) 不是 Locked。沿途份额保持为三（lock_share_stays）。

laws.en: Three.rise_lock_ends: the same with the share raised by one under the favouring rule (riseShare, riseAfter): every premise of locked_ends_with_net_regime holds, the share is 3 + n after n steps (rise_orbit) and above three after every step (rise_above), and the line ends Locked at ((7, true, 4), 0). The use reads only the rule, so the rise draws no more.
laws.zh: Three.rise_lock_ends：同上而份额在偏向的规则下每步加一（riseShare、riseAfter）：locked_ends_with_net_regime 的前提皆成立，n 步后份额为 3 + n（rise_orbit），每步之后都高于三（rise_above），线终于 ((7, true, 4), 0)，仍 Locked。用量只读规则，所以份额上升并未多取。

laws.en: With the window giving the rule false (Three.noRule), from (3, true, 0) at nine: read at eight only, [8, 9), the right side of turns_in_time_iff holds at T = 1 and the line ends in five steps (read_at_eight_ends); read on [6, 10), the line never ends from nine and ends from seven (read_to_ten); read on [6, 9), first read at step 1, the level holds at six and the line never ends (held_at_six). In the last two the kind is not kept at every level.
laws.zh: 窗口给出规则 false（Three.noRule），自九处的 (3, true, 0)：只在八读取（[8, 9)）时，turns_in_time_iff 的右边在 T = 1 成立而线五步终止（read_at_eight_ends）；在 [6, 10) 读取时，自九线不穷、自七终止（read_to_ten）；在 [6, 9) 读取时，第 1 步初读，水位守在六，线不穷（held_at_six）。后两者该类并非在每个水位都被保持。

laws.en: Three.unlocked_goes_on: from (2, true, 0) at nine, which is not Locked, with the window [6, 8), the line never ends and no step of the lock's own course is at a level the window reads, so the right side of locked_turns_in_time_on_window_iff fails while the line never ends; that every other premise holds there is argued in its docstring, not a Lean statement.
laws.zh: Three.unlocked_goes_on：自九处不是 Locked 的 (2, true, 0)，窗口 [6, 8)：线不穷，锁自己的进程没有一步落在窗口所读的水位，所以 locked_turns_in_time_on_window_iff 的右边不成立而线不穷；其余前提在此皆成立，由其文档中的论证给出，不是 Lean 陈述。

laws.en: kept_within: where the step under no use keeps every level up to hi within hi, the step under any use from a level at most hi leaves a level at most hi. rises_from: a use that rises strictly at each of the first n steps of alone's orbit is at least j after j steps, for every j up to n.
laws.zh: kept_within：不用时的一步把不高于 hi 的水位保持在 hi 以内，则任何用量下自不高于 hi 的水位的一步也留下不高于 hi 的水位。rises_from：用量沿 alone 的轨道在前 n 步每步严格上升，则 j 步之后不少于 j，对每个不超过 n 的 j 皆然。

laws.en: rising_takes_all: with nothing given from nothing, the step under no use keeping every level up to hi within hi, a start at most hi and the use rising strictly at each of the first hi steps of alone's orbit, the level of the course as it was at step hi + 1 is nothing; the rise is given. rising_meets_level: under those premises without nothing from nothing, the first step at which the use is at least the level comes within hi steps.
laws.zh: rising_takes_all：无中不生有，不用时的一步把不高于 hi 的水位保持在 hi 以内，起点不高于 hi，用量沿 alone 的轨道在前 hi 步每步严格上升：照旧进程在第 hi + 1 步的水位为零；上升是给定的。rising_meets_level：同样前提而不要求无中不生有，用量第一次不低于水位的一步在 hi 步之内。

laws.en: ends_with_net_rising: with AloneOutside, a positive need no marked level meets, nothing given from nothing, the step under no use keeping every level up to hi within hi, a start at most hi and the use rising strictly at each of the first hi steps of alone's orbit, the line reaches within hi + 1 steps a configuration that conditions nothing, its way alone taken that many times. What is concluded is an ending; the rise of the use is given.
laws.zh: ends_with_net_rising：有 AloneOutside，所需为正且无标记水位满足它，无中不生有，不用时的一步把不高于 hi 的水位保持在 hi 以内，起点不高于 hi，用量沿 alone 的轨道在前 hi 步每步严格上升：线在 hi + 1 步之内到达无所缘的构形，其方式是 alone 连取那么多次。结论是终止；用量的上升是给定的。

laws.en: locked_ends_rising: under the lock's premises from a Locked start, AloneOutside at windowAlone, a positive need no marked level meets, nothing given from nothing, the step under no use keeping levels up to hi within hi, a start at most hi, and every way whose share and rule are not below the start's using strictly less than the way the lock's step makes of it (more): the line ends within hi + 1 steps, still Locked. The rise of the use is given.
laws.zh: locked_ends_rising：在锁的前提下自 Locked 的起点，windowAlone 处的 AloneOutside，所需为正且无标记水位满足它，无中不生有，不用时的一步把不高于 hi 的水位保持在 hi 以内，起点不高于 hi，份额与规则不低于起点的方式所取严格少于锁的一步由它所成的方式（more）：线在 hi + 1 步之内终止，仍 Locked。用量的上升是给定的。

laws.en: count_rises gives locked_ends_rising's more where the share is a natural number every favouring rule raises strictly, the use is that number times a positive amount, favouring is kept by a rule not lower and the start's rule favours. No law concludes that the use depends on the share or the rule.
laws.zh: count_rises 给出 locked_ends_rising 的 more，条件是份额为每个偏向的规则都使之严格增加的自然数、用量是它乘以一个正数、偏向被不更低的规则保持、起点的规则偏向。没有哪条律推出用量取决于份额或规则。

laws.en: windowAfterShare fA hA sA hL N K: at a level in [N, K) the share is set by sA and the rule by hL; at every other level it is the lock's step as it was, reading at every step (window_share_alone_outside). windowAfter reading at every step is, pointwise, its case with the share set by fA (windowAfter_every_is_share).
laws.zh: windowAfterShare fA hA sA hL N K：在 [N, K) 的水位上份额由 sA、规则由 hL 设定；在其余水位上是锁照旧、每步都读取的步（window_share_alone_outside）。每步都读取的 windowAfter 逐点是它以 fA 设定份额的情形（windowAfter_every_is_share）。

laws.en: locked_turns_in_time_share_iff: turns_in_time_iff at the kind of ways with a Low share and a kept rule, on windowAfterShare: under the lock's premises from a Locked start, with sets, lowRule, lowStays, the floor H₁ where share and rule are not below the start's, the start below H₁ + y₁ and at most hi, giving short of H₁ below y₁, the Low, kept ways using H₂, nothing given from nothing, RegimeMargin's premises for H₂ up to hi and a positive need at most H₂ + y₂, no premise on where the window lies: the line never ends exactly where, at the first step of the lock's own course in [N, K), the need met there and before, the level one step later is at or above H₂ + y₂.
laws.zh: locked_turns_in_time_share_iff：windowAfterShare 上、以份额 Low 且规则 kept 的方式为保持之类的 turns_in_time_iff：在锁的前提下自 Locked 的起点，有 sets、lowRule、lowStays，份额与规则不低于起点处的下限 H₁，起点低于 H₁ + y₁ 且不高于 hi，y₁ 以下所给不足 H₁，Low、kept 的方式取用 H₂，无中不生有，RegimeMargin 在 H₂ 处以 y₂ 至 hi 的前提（Short、Meets、Keeps），所需为正且不超过 H₂ + y₂，对窗口位置不设前提：线不穷，当且仅当在锁自己的进程第一个落在 [N, K) 的一步（此处及此前所需皆满足），一步之后的水位不低于 H₂ + y₂。

laws.en: share_corrected_stays: with sets, lowRule and lowStays, after a step of the pair's course at a level in [N, K) the share is Low and the rule kept at every later step; share_corrected_on_course: so from the step after the first step at which the course as it was is at a level the window reads. Neither says anything of the level, the use or whether the line goes on.
laws.zh: share_corrected_stays：有 sets、lowRule、lowStays 时，这个对的进程在 [N, K) 的水位走一步之后，此后每一步份额为 Low、规则为 kept；share_corrected_on_course：故自照旧进程第一个落在窗口所读水位的一步之后即如此。两者对水位、用量或线是否继续都不作陈述。

laws.en: Three.rise_count_ends: with the use the share (drawerUse), the share raised by one at each step under the favouring rule, from (3, true, 0) at twelve, every premise of locked_ends_rising holds at hi = 12, more from count_rises, and the line ends Locked within 13 steps; computed, in seven at ((10, true, 7), 0). At the start no H at most the start's use and y with giving short of H below y put twelve below H + y.
laws.zh: Three.rise_count_ends：用量即份额（drawerUse），份额在偏向的规则下每步加一，自十二处的 (3, true, 0)：hi = 12 时 locked_ends_rising 的前提皆成立（more 由 count_rises），线在 13 步之内终止，仍 Locked；计算得七步终于 ((10, true, 7), 0)。在起点，没有不超过起点用量的 H 与使 y 以下所给不足 H 的 y 让十二低于 H + y。

laws.en: Three.share_read_goes_on: on the window [8, 9) setting the share to nothing (zeroShare) and the rule to false, from (3, true, 0) at nine, the course is ((3, true, 1), 8), then ((0, false, n + 2), 6) for every n; the line never ends, through locked_turns_in_time_share_iff at T = 1, and from step 2 the share is below three and the rule false.
laws.zh: Three.share_read_goes_on：窗口 [8, 9) 把份额设为零（zeroShare）、规则设为 false，自九处的 (3, true, 0)：进程为 ((3, true, 1), 8)，此后对每个 n 为 ((0, false, n + 2), 6)；线不穷（经 locked_turns_in_time_share_iff 于 T = 1），自第 2 步起份额低于三、规则为 false。

hypotheses.en: No axiom. Discrete steps; any type of ways and whole-number levels; one function giving the way after a step and one giving the level after it, each of the way and the level.
Which levels make a difference to the way is given: the marked levels and alone (AloneOutside) are a premise of every theorem that uses them.

A kept kind is kept at every step (kept), a way after a marked step is of it (turns), and every way of it has one standing use H₂ (uses); with these the course after the turn has one point of no return.
Where the regime is used, the level's step is RegimeMargin.step giving (use w), one giving for every way and nothing given from nothing: the way enters the level's step only through use.

For the fate after the turn: giving short of H₂ below y₂ and meeting it from y₂ up to hi, the step under H₂ keeping the level within hi, a positive need at most H₂ + y₂, the level at most hi. For the course as it was: giving short of H₁ below y₁, every way on alone's orbit using at least H₁, the start below H₁ + y₁.

The split at the first marked level needs the course as it was to come below the need and whether a level is marked decided; ending where the net ends needs a positive need and no marked level that meets it.
constant_iff_needs_nothing needs some way given; locked_at_class is stated where the beyond is a whole number, as ClosedCapture.lockedAlike is.
For locked_closed and locked_at_class: RuleCapture's Raises and ReadsShare and favouring kept upward; no Accrues; the joined two-level step total, which is the net at a need of nothing.

For the laws where the kind is kept only below a level: c above nothing; the kept kind kept by every step at a level from H₂ + y₂ up to below c (keptBelow); every way's step taking every level from c up to hi to one from c up to hi (safe); every way the course reaches using at least H₂ (floor); in turns_in_time_iff_kept_below, the level of the course as it was after every marked step at most hi (high) in place of the start at most hi.

For the lock on the regime: RuleCapture's Raises and ReadsShare, favouring kept upward and a Locked start; AloneOutside at windowAlone; a positive need no marked level meets; nothing given from nothing. Then either giving short of H below y, the floor H on the use where share and rule are not below the start's (draws) and the start below H + y; or the cap of the rising laws and more, the rise of the use given.

On the window: every step reads; the reading gives a kept rule at every level in [N, K) (corrects), with N ≤ H₂ + y₂ and c ≤ K, every way using at least H₂ and the ways with a kept rule H₂; or, where it sets the share too, a Low share and a kept rule there (sets), the rule read off a Low share kept (lowRule), a Low share staying Low under a kept rule (lowStays), the Low, kept ways using H₂, with the regime premises for H₂ up to hi and a positive need at most H₂ + y₂. Both window laws also take the overdraw of the course as it was as given (giving short of H₁ below y₁, the floor H₁ where share and rule are not below the start's, the start below H₁ + y₁) and a bound hi: on the level after each step the window reads, or on the start where the share is set too.

For the rising laws: the step under no use keeping every level up to hi within hi (RegimeMargin.Keeps giving 0 hi) and the start at most hi; the use rising strictly at each of the first hi steps of alone's orbit (rises). count_rises asks a share that is a natural number every favouring rule raises strictly, a use that is that number times a positive amount, favouring kept upward and the start's rule favouring.

does_not_show.en: How what brings a level's difference to a way comes to stand: the marks and alone are given.
That what brings a level's difference to a way stands on the level whose difference it brings: that the marked levels are levels of the quantity the going on needs is a choice of the model.
That the kept kind is kept at every step, or has one standing use: both are premises.
That the courses of RuleCapture's and ClosedCapture's models need nothing of what they use: their step is total by construction, so in them no line ends where the net ends.
Reading in time on the pair beyond the point of no return: ReadOffInTime's selection side (FirstApart, TellsApartAt, ReadableInTime) is not instantiated; the pair has no web.
Continuations other than a turn of the course to one standing use: they are not among the feasible courses.
That FourReaders.recoverable_iff_regime follows from recoverable_iff_above: its courses are over three places and its course as it was is not of RegimeMargin.step's form.
That ClosedCapture's and PoolFromCourse's theorems on their own loop (course_past, window_past_course, window_never_read) follow from agrees_until_marked: they keep their own proofs.
Anything about a trained system, or that any actual course has this pair's form.
That comparing the three levels is new: of the near work, several papers were read only in part or from an abstract.

detail.en: Against reading a turn as enough: in Three, first marked at six the way turns with two left, below the kept kind's point of no return six, and two steps later the line conditions nothing (Three.turned_and_ends); first marked at nine or eight it never ends (Three.goes_on).

Against the class of ways being constant up to the net's end where a level makes a difference: marked at six, the line under that class ends at six while the net goes on, so the class is not constant up to the net's end, nor at the class of the configuration with level six (Three.line_ends_while_net_goes).

validation_scope.en: Pure core, axiom reports empty (scratch build of 16 November: 105 public declarations, 78 of them theorems, and 35 private lemmas); imported by Becoming.LineOnAStock and Becoming.WayOfUnits, in the Lean's second layer only through two theorems it imports. Compositions of landed theorems (Optimum's, RegimeMargin's, the root's, the joined two-level step, RuleCapture's lock) with one split at the first marked level; the witnesses computed. Written by AI agents and read by AI agents set to refute it, the laws of 16 November among them; no person's review of it is recorded yet.

next_delta.en: Prove ClosedCapture's and PoolFromCourse's courses instances of the pair, so that their own-loop theorems are derived below from agrees_until_marked; move «类闭则本类常闭» and first_of_decided down, putting the module in the first layer; give the step T in closed form by Optimum.reread_deadline_iff; a test on a trained system, held.

correspondence.en: Reading (AI-written, from the home section's reading and the study folder's NEAR-WORK): in the root's words the centre is one sentence with two endings: a line that stays alike in a respect ends where the net ends, or ends while the net goes on. The first is the Locked course of RuleCapture and ClosedCapture outliving what it draws down, once what is drawn down is a level the going on needs; the second is turning before the end. Which happens is a matter of three levels of one quantity: where its fall first makes a difference to the way, the level that step leaves, and the level from which it holds under the lesser use. Read whole: Pezzey and Anderies 2001 and 2002 (a response switched on at a chosen threshold, the need to come in time said in words), Brander and Taylor 1998, HANDY 2014; the Lock-in Hypothesis and Gradual Disempowerment through summaries. In part: Turchin 2009 (a corrective that draws on a surplus growth erodes), Muneepeerakul and Anderies 2020. From an abstract only: Self-Sealing Reward Models (an exact boundary past which an evaluator loop cannot be refuted), Dalton and Coats 2000. None compares the three levels or is machine-checked; nothing here is called new.
